author: Aldiandya Irsyad
install_msg: Configure scheduleset forum, optionally scheduleset sharechannel, then settimezone before scheduling. Run help schedule for examples.
name: Schedule
short: Schedules a game within a forum post.
description: A command to create a simple LFG schedule message in a Discord forum post, automatically using the post's title as the game name.
end_user_data_statement: Stores member timezone preferences per server and event organizer/attendee Discord IDs, channel/message IDs, event details, and action timestamps. Event messages and announcements are also posted to Discord.
